pages.text: $(item)Empty Pages$() are blank stock. $(item)Symbol Pages$() are the actual words of an Age. $(item)Lost Pages$() identify into weighted random symbols, with practical pages appearing often and dangerous or valuable pages appearing rarely.

$(item)Leather$() by itself in the $(thing)Book Binder$() creates a blank $(item)Descriptive Book$(). This is your drafting vessel. Add symbol pages to it over time until the grammar says what you want.

$(item)Leather$() plus an $(item)Empty Page$() in the binder creates a $(item)Linking Book$(). If symbol pages are in the binder too, they are left behind instead of being consumed, so you can write a link without destroying your grammar pages.

The blue field in the binder names the Age before first use. That draft name becomes the dimension id, cleaned into a valid path. If the name already exists, Mystcraft keeps it readable and adds a suffix instead of overwriting another world.
